lede: This week: Paramount+ sleeps on a 94% piano-tuner heist, Ryan Murphy's superfan AHS reunion tops Hulu, Netflix's luchador-packed Physical 100 lands, and the announced slate is led by Sacrifice, East of Eden and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

shortlist.title: Tuner
shortlist.meta: Dir. Daniel Roher; with Leo Woodall, Dustin Hoffman, Havana Rose Liu. 107 min.
shortlist.blurb: Oscar-winning Navalny director Daniel Roher's fiction debut: a New York piano tuner with hypersensitive hearing starts cracking safes to pay for his ailing mentor's medical bills. Daredevil meets The Italian Job with a classical-music heart, and it's Paramount+'s biggest streaming hit right now.

shortlist.title: American Horror Story: 13
shortlist.meta: Ryan Murphy; with Jessica Lange, Angela Bassett, Kathy Bates, Joey Pollari. 13 episodes, released in pairs and trios through Oct 29.
shortlist.blurb: A hospice caretaker with triskaidekaphobia takes a job at The Apollyon, a Manhattan building haunted by characters from seasons past. Critics are raving about Lange's return, though the audience score is a split 42%.

shortlist.title: Physical: 100 Mexico
shortlist.meta: Netflix reality competition; 100 contestants including luchadores Místico, Atlantis Jr. and Soberano Jr., Olympians and MMA champions. Seven-episode first drop.
shortlist.blurb: The second country adaptation of the Korean hit (after Italy) pits Mexican wrestlers, divers, gymnasts and Hyrox athletes against brutal physical challenges. The Korean original's format, with luchador spectacle added.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.blurb: Pixar's latest arrives on Disney+ about three months after its June theatrical run, with more Jessie backstory.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.blurb: Lili Reinhart and Tom Bateman headline a breezy rom-com adaptation of the bestselling novel. RT 76%, Metacritic 59.

anime.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3
anime.blurb: Early fall simulcast premiere on Crunchyroll, ahead of the main October slate.

catalog.title: Possession
catalog.blurb: Andrzej Zulawski's extreme possession-horror landmark is in the Criterion Channel's October 'Possessions' collection alongside The Wailing and Jennifer's Body.

catalog.title: The Keep
catalog.blurb: Michael Mann's cult WWII horror oddity joins Criterion in October, with a Kiyoshi Kurosawa spotlight and The Complete Kubrick.

catalog.title: The Menu
catalog.blurb: The chef-thriller satire is among roughly 25 horror and thriller films (Evil Dead, The Sixth Sense, Hush) in Netflix's October 1 batch.

announced.title: Sacrifice
announced.blurb: Netflix set an October 16 date and released the trailer for Romain Gavras' satirical thriller with Anya Taylor-Joy, Chris Evans and Vincent Cassel, which debuted at TIFF in 2025. Track it now.

announced.title: East of Eden
announced.blurb: All seven episodes of Zoe Kazan's Steinbeck adaptation with Florence Pugh, Christopher Abbott and Mike Faist drop tomorrow on Netflix.

announced.title: War
announced.blurb: HBO and Sky's eight-part divorce drama with Dominic West and Sienna Miller premieres October 1; early reviews are mixed but praise the cast.

announced.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
announced.blurb: Netflix set an October 20 date for the ten-episode standalone Night City follow-up, with Bartosz Sztybor showrunning and Kai Ikarashi directing.

announced.title: The Apothecary Diaries
announced.blurb: Season 3 premieres October 2 on Crunchyroll with 12 episodes this fall and 12 more in spring 2027; Black Clover Season 2 follows October 3.

announced.title: Nocturne
announced.blurb: Apple TV released the trailer and set an October 30 premiere for the thriller with Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz and Stephen Graham, weekly through Dec 25.
Apple TV set a November 13 premiere for the 1970s crime thriller with Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, releasing weekly through Dec 25.

announced.title: Crystal Lake
announced.blurb: Peacock and A24's eight-episode Friday the 13th prequel series arrives October 15.

announced.title: The Remarried Empress
announced.blurb: Disney+ and Hulu will premiere the Naver Webtoon adaptation on November 4 with four episodes, then two each Wednesday through Nov 25.
